points: At the very end of the kingdom, with Bavel marching on Yerushalayim, Tzidkiyahu sends messengers asking Yirmiyahu to daven, hoping for a miracle like in Yeshayahu's time.
Hashem's answer: your own weapons will be turned against you and the city will be destroyed in great anger.
The only way out: leave the city and surrender to Bavel. Some Jews did, and were taken captive instead of killed.
The final message to the house of Dovid: treat those at the bottom of society, the yasom and the almanah, with kindness and justice.
For people with power and influence, the greatest obligation is to look out for the forgotten. That's what can keep them from being wiped out.
